tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere; the dark value is flok's terminal ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised areas: the selected list row, an open picker, the one-line prompt.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: code blocks in the preview, the search and append input.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Pane borders and the rule under the brand line. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Rules that must stay visible: the horizontal rule in the preview, the border of an open picker. At least 3:1 on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: note titles, the rendered note body (15:1 and up in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, paths, footer verbs, the unpushed count, abandoned reports. 5:1 or better on ground and surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders in the prompt only. Below 4.5:1 by design; never for text a person must read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interactive colour: the selection bar, footer keys, links and headings in the preview, the syncing spinner, in-progress reports.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill: the H1 band in the preview, the alert-free badges of the later Mac app.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a highlighted search match, and of text selected in the note (in ink).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus in the later Mac and iOS apps: 2px solid ring, 2px offset. The terminal shows focus with the selection bar instead.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Logo ink only: the nt mark and the [nt] wordmark brackets. Cyan on dark grounds, W4J teal on light.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: W4J teal, the tie to w4jnl: favicon tile, avatar, app icon. White on it is 3.5:1, fine for the mark, never for body text.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Good state: synced, a finished agent report. Same values as vink's up. As text 5:1+ on ground, surface and ok-soft.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind an ok glyph and word where a fill is wanted (Mac app badges).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs a look, nothing lost: offline, a blocked agent. Same values as vink's late.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind a warn glyph and word.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Act now: a sync conflict or error, a failed agent, destructive confirmations. Same values as vink's down.

tokens.name: alert-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind an alert glyph and word.

tokens.name: on-alert
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an alert fill (the alert mark tile).

tokens.name: synced
tokens.usage: Sync state: everything committed and pushed. Glyph ●.

tokens.name: syncing
tokens.usage: Sync state: a cycle is running. Glyph ◐◓◑◒ (spinner).

tokens.name: unpushed
tokens.usage: Sync state: commits waiting for the next push. Shown as ↑N, never as a warning.

tokens.name: offline
tokens.usage: Sync state: the remote is out of reach; the next cycle retries. Glyph ◌ (dashed ring).

tokens.name: conflict
tokens.usage: Sync state: a conflict copy was made, or sync stopped with an error. Glyph ◆.

tokens.name: in-progress
tokens.usage: Agent report: the session is running. Glyph is flok's working spinner.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Agent report: the session ended normally. Glyph ✓.

tokens.name: blocked
tokens.usage: Agent report: the agent waits on a person. Glyph ●.

tokens.name: failed
tokens.usage: Agent report: the session ended with an error. Glyph ◆.

tokens.name: abandoned
tokens.usage: Agent report: the session ended without a result. Glyph ○.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Brand
groups.note: JetBrains Mono, as in flok and vink: the wordmark and every piece of brand imagery. In the terminal, nt is set in the person's own terminal font.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name beside the mark. Lockups use the outlined SVGs; this style is for places that set it live.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: plain markdown notes, synced by git
styles.usage: Headlines on the README hero and the social card.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: App icon and avatar tiles (W4J's rounded square); favicon uses 7 of 32.

tokens.name: list-width
tokens.usage: Width of the folder list in columns until the person drags the divider or presses < >; nt remembers the width per machine. Fits nine in ten dated titles.

tokens.name: list-step
tokens.usage: Columns one press of < or > moves the divider.

tokens.name: list-min
tokens.usage: Minimum list width in columns; below list-min + preview-min the preview hides and Enter shows the note full width.

tokens.name: preview-min
tokens.usage: Minimum preview width in columns.

tokens.name: preview-max
tokens.usage: Maximum wrap width of the rendered note, for line length; wider panes keep the margin on the right.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Columns between the selection bar and the text, and between the panes.

tokens.name: selection-bar
tokens.usage: Left edge of the selected row in accent: the terminal form of the family's 6px accent bar.
